text: The CRCF allocates approximately $16.8 million across 12 councils for 50 projects. Notable allocations include $4.89 million for Auckland Council to accelerate land categorization and voluntary buyouts, and $4.75 million for Gisborne District Council for multiple recovery initiatives. The fund aims to shorten decision and delivery timelines, enabling faster recovery and resilience building.

metadata.solution_name: Cyclone Recovery Capability Fund (CRCF) — councils’ capability support for recovery functions, including voluntary buyouts, under Budget 2024
